workflow.title: Release Discovery, Reporting & Cleanup Entry
workflow.description: Current framework, characterization, submission, and cleanup-entry resources for handling a discovered release in Connecticut.

relationships.workflow_note: Review the current program framework, maintained guidance, reporting resources, cleanup pathways, professional-role materials, and implementation updates.
Consult the controlling regulations for release discovery, reporting, characterization, immediate-action, cleanup, tiering, and closure provisions.
Review the current framework for historical releases presenting increased short-term risk and the associated immediate-action process.
Use when developing the conceptual site model and investigation approach for an identified release and affected environmental media.
Search the property and release record, manage the applicable case, and access current submission and tracking functions.
Review the current tier-assignment framework and REACT handoff when a release proceeds beyond the initial characterization and closure period.
